reasons_for: Jordan imported about 67.5 million USD under HS 854143 in 2024.
That is about 19,580 tonnes of imports in 2024.
The import figures are official UN Comtrade statistics reported by Jordan.
concerns: No cost data: the import price per kg, the customs duty and an estimated local production cost are needed to compare local production with imports.
No manufacturing data: machinery, raw-material and skills availability in Jordan are unknown.
No competition data: the number of local factories already making this product is unknown.
next_steps: Check that HS 854143 really matches your product (Jordan Customs tariff or WITS); the import figures belong to that code.
Get supplier quotes for machines and raw materials to estimate the local production cost per kg.
Ask the Jordan Chamber of Industry how many local factories make this product.
